vscode.new-recipe.smith-printed-its-leve: smith printed its levels in a form this editor does not read. Update the extension, or run smith recipe new in a terminal.
vscode.new-recipe.smith-knows-no-plugin-: smith knows no plugin a recipe can fix. Update smith, or run smith recipe new in a terminal.
vscode.new-recipe.write-the-question-the: Write the question the people who use the recipe read.
vscode.new-recipe.write-the-question-wit: Write the question without a colon.
vscode.new-recipe.an-answer-is-a-word-or: An answer is a word or two, without : = + or a comma.
vscode.new-recipe.two-answers-are-named-: Two answers are named "{trim}": each needs its own name.
vscode.new-recipe.use-lowercase-words-jo: Use lowercase words joined by dashes, for example "team" or "team-node". The name is the name of the recipe's releases.
vscode.new-recipe.lowercase-words-joined: Lowercase words joined by dashes. The file is <name>.recipe.toml.
vscode.new-recipe.base-recipe-toml-a-pat: base.recipe.toml (a path or an https URL; enter for none)
vscode.new-recipe.the-new-recipe-starts-: The new recipe starts from that one and changes what it names.
vscode.new-recipe.unset-the-recipe-it-ex: Unset: the recipe it extends, or the person who uses the recipe, decides.
vscode.new-recipe.which-plugins-does-the: {title}: which {level} plugins does the recipe fix?
vscode.new-recipe.tick-the-plugins-tick-: Tick the plugins{fit}; tick none to leave it unset. {whenLeftOut}
vscode.new-recipe.which-plugin-does-the-: {title}: which {level} plugin does the recipe fix?
vscode.new-recipe.every-project-made-fro: every project made from the recipe gets the {level} plugin you pick next, or none
vscode.new-recipe.smith-asks-them-a-ques: smith asks them a question for the {level} when they make a project; each answer gives a plugin
vscode.new-recipe.the-people-who-make-a-: The people who make a project from the recipe read it. Do not use a colon.
vscode.new-recipe.which-plugins-can-they: {title}: which {level} plugins can they end up with?
vscode.new-recipe.tick-at-least-two-a-ch: Tick at least two: a choice with one answer is a fixed plugin
vscode.new-recipe.monosmith-a-choice-nee: MonoSmith: a choice needs at least two plugins. Tick two or more, or fix the plugin instead.
vscode.new-recipe.what-the-user-reads-fo: What the user reads for this plugin. Enter keeps the plugin name.
vscode.new-recipe.name-another-answer-or: Name another answer, or leave it empty to finish.
vscode.new-recipe.a-word-or-two-the-user: A word or two the user reads. A choice needs at least two answers.
vscode.new-recipe.tick-one-or-more-sever: Tick one or more; several are installed together
vscode.new-recipe.monosmith-wrote-check-: MonoSmith: wrote {file}. Check it any time with smith recipe check {file2} --all.
